A CLOSER LOOK

Exploration is a team effort

Astronauts train, conduct experiments, operate spacecraft and work with large teams on the ground. These three profiles are a starting point in a much larger human story.

LIFE BEYOND EARTH

More than the launch.

01 / PREPARE

Rehearse on Earth

Simulators, technical study and team exercises help crews practice operations before a mission.

02 / EXPLORE

Work in microgravity

Crews conduct research, maintain equipment and adapt familiar tasks to an environment of continual free fall.

03 / CONNECT

Stay part of a team

Mission control, engineers, scientists and support staff help astronauts carry out their work safely and effectively.
